findings.title: The tide table has no date, no example label and no height reference
findings.viewer_experience: A harbor master cannot tell if these are live tides or a sample, which day they are for, or what level 4.8 m is measured from. This is the doubt the headline promises to remove.

current.value: card heading says only "Today at Porthmellin"; no date, example label or height reference near the table

findings.target: The card is labeled as an example of the page Tidewell posts, and shows a date and a height reference.
findings.fix_direction: Label the card as an example of the page Tidewell posts, and add a date and the height reference. Only the maker can supply the height reference (the level the heights are measured from) and the date.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic must see, near the tide table in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, a label that marks it as an example, a date, and a height reference.

findings.title: The preview shows only tides, not the gate times, pontoon depth and notices the page names
findings.viewer_experience: The viewer sees a tide table, not the one page with gate times, pontoon depth and notices that the paragraph next to it describes.
findings.target: The card also shows the three features the page already names: lock gate times, depth at the pontoon, and notices.
findings.fix_direction: Add rows for only those three features the page already names. The maker must supply the values.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic must see, in the tide card in the desktop, tablet and widescreen images, rows for gate times, pontoon depth and notices.

findings.title: Nothing compares Tidewell with how offices post times now
findings.viewer_experience: The reader must take "can stand behind" on trust.

current.value: no line or image compares Tidewell with the current method

findings.target: One line or image sets Tidewell beside the current method.
findings.fix_direction: Add one line or image that sets Tidewell beside the current method. The maker must supply the comparison.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic must see, in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, one line or image that sets Tidewell beside how offices post times now.

findings.title: The page ends below the points with nothing to do next

location.description: the blank lower band below the three points

findings.viewer_experience: The page ends at about y 610 of 800 (y 610 of 1080 on widescreen) and gives the viewer nothing to do next.

current.value: content ends at about y 610 on desktop and widescreen, with no button or footer below the points

findings.target: A repeated button or a footer sits below the points.
findings.fix_direction: Repeat the button or add a footer.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic must see, in the desktop and widescreen images, a repeated button or a footer below the three points.

findings.title: On the tablet each point heading sits about 200 px from its text

location.description: the tablet points, starting with Lock gate times

findings.viewer_experience: Each heading is closer to the white space than to its own text, so heading and sentence do not read as a pair.

current.value: heading at x 64 and text at x 408, about 200 px of white space between

findings.target: Each heading sits over its text, or the text sits directly beside its heading.
findings.fix_direction: Stack each heading over its text, or put the text directly beside its heading.

closed_when.check: in the tablet viewport, the left edge x of each section.points > div.point > p equals the left edge x of its h3 (stacked), or the gap between the right edge of the h3 and the left edge of the p is under 40 px
